verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy are fair questions for a database with SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only data/table versioning (snapshots, time travel, branching), which is a different feature from versioned APIs. No API version scheme or deprecation policy appears, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
